dependencies.name: Node.js 22+
dependencies.purpose: Runs the local-first Rhize Tasks planning service and its validation commands.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Rhize Tasks cannot start, validate, or run its local planning routines.

replacement.suggestion: Install a supported Node.js 22 or newer runtime.
replacement.warning: Older Node versions do not provide the supported runtime floor for this plugin.

dependencies.name: macOS 14+
dependencies.purpose: Provides Keychain and EventKit support for local credentials and Apple Reminders.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Rhize Tasks cannot provide its supported local Keychain and Apple Reminders integration.

replacement.suggestion: Use a Mac running macOS 14 or newer.
replacement.warning: The plugin has no supported replacement for the macOS Keychain and EventKit integration.
